court: In the High Court of Madras
advocates: For Petitioner(s): Mr. E. Manoharan for Mr. B. Sasidaran
For Respondent(s): Ms. Akila Rajendran, Government Advocate
prayer: PRAYER: Writ petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, pleased to issue a Writ of Mandamus, directing the respondents 2 and 3 to register the Judgment and decree passed in O.S. No. 2727 of 2019 and to pass orders on the representation submitted by the petitioner dated 17.05.2025.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Senthilkumar Ramamoorthy, J.:— The petitioner's father had filed a civil suit challenging inter alia Document Nos. 4568 of 2013 and 4569 of 2013. The suit was re-numbered as O.S. No. 2727 of 2019 and decreed on 12.02.2020. When presented for registration, the petitioner states that the registering officer was unwilling to register the same. Hence this writ petition.

2. Ms. Akila Rajendran, learned Government Advocate, accepts notice for all the respondents. On the basis of written instructions, it is stated that the decree would be registered within two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order. It is also stated that the necessary entry would be made in the register of encumbrances.

3. Recording the same, this writ petition is disposed of by directing the registering officer to register the decree and make necessary entries in the encumbrance register within three weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order, subject to fulfilment of other requirements relating to the registration. No costs.
